title: Lumen Reach 0.7.1 -> 0.7.2: roof ramp access and roof bridge clearance
subtitle: Exact poses, private Intel nested, Medium 0.5 scale, core 0735e4d; columns differ only by package. Navmesh map: screenshots/navmesh-2026-10-09/lumen-0.7.2-navmesh.png

rows.title: Final roof ramp foot, from above the court
rows.caption: 0.7.1: the ramp starts flush with the y=12 slab's open front lip; rails start 0.5 m up, so the foot was reachable only with the body hanging over the drop. 0.7.2: a 1.5 m apron with a parapet and end returns in front of the foot.

rows.title: Same spot at eye height, from the west
rows.caption: 0.7.2: the apron runs past the ramp foot behind a 1.0 m guard rail; roof-start/roof-start-west now stand on the main navmesh (navmesh-allow pin removed).

rows.title: Roof bridge through the Array Hall west bay, eye height
rows.caption: 0.7.1: a render-only metal lintel at 0.88-1.12 m and a concrete rib inside the 1.5 m walkway (walked through). 0.7.2: lintel raised to clear 2.28 m; rib stops under the deck and resumes 2.6 m above it; route centreline mid-bridge (route-clearance pins removed).
